evidence.evidence_text: In this paper, we present DocLLM, a lightweight extension to traditional large language models (LLMs) for reasoning over visual documents, taking into account both textual semantics and spatial layout.
We demonstrate that our solution outperforms SotA LLMs on 14 out of 16 datasets across all tasks, and generalizes well to 4 out of 5 previously unseen datasets.
The pre-trained model is fine-tuned using a large-scale instruction dataset, covering four core document intelligence tasks.
